mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte derangements (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which impair renal clearance of lisdexamfetamine and its active metabolite amphetamine, while stimulants increase cardiovascular stress during fungal infection treatment.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor renal function, electrolytes, cardiac status, and blood pressure closely; consider alternative antifungal therapy.
